r13b-001.gate_key: present_simple_passive | A2.2 | gap | Write one word in each gap: The windows of our office are ___ ___ a small company every month. (clean) |

item.q: Write one word in each gap: The windows of our office are ___ ___ a small company every month. (clean)
item.why: After *are* the 3rd form: *are cleaned*. The doer comes after *by*: *by a small company*.
item.why_lv: Aiz *are* vajag 3. formu: *are cleaned*. Darītājs nāk aiz *by*: *by a small company*.

r13b-002.gate_key: irregular_plurals | A2.2 | text | Correct the mistake: Your trousers looks great with that jacket. |

accepted: Your trousers look great with that jacket.

item.q: Correct the mistake: Your trousers looks great with that jacket.
item.why: *trousers* is always plural, so the verb has no *-s*: *Your trousers look great*, not *looks*.
item.why_lv: *trousers* vienmēr ir daudzskaitlī, tāpēc darbības vārds ir bez *-s*: *Your trousers look great*, nevis *looks*.
answers: Your trousers look great with that jacket.
